scenicChapters.title: Romania Transalpina
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 39 km this is Romania Transalpina, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-rosia-montana-mining-landscape-vo.story: 351 km from Roșia Montană to Roșia Montană, about 6 h 03 of riding. It goes by way of Ighiu - Dealul Măgulici, Village of Câlnic, Cugir - Bătrâna and Voineasa - Crac-Găuri. The highest point is about 1,600 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Fortlet Wingertsberg → Fortlet Lochmühle
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 40 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-fort-site-and-civil-settlement-of.story: A 285 km round trip from Hammersbach - roughly 4 h 55 in the saddle. On the way it passes Fortlet Wingertsberg, Fortlet Lochmühle, Watchtower WP 3/23* and Watchtower WP 2/31. The line favours views over speed.
